mapper.select: SELECT * FROM news_like WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND news_id = #{postId} AND (is_deleted IS NULL OR is_deleted = 0) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO news_like (news_id, user_id, is_cancel, create_time, update_time, is_deleted) VALUES (#{postId}, #{userId}, #{isCancel}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE news_like SET is_cancel = #{isCancel}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
